edits.text: PARTIES. This Agreement is between Vireo Systems Inc., a company incorporated in [jurisdiction to be confirmed] (the “Company”), and [Executive’s full legal name] (the “Executive”), effective as of [date to be agreed].

1. POSITION. The Executive shall serve as Chief Operating Officer, report to the Chief Executive Officer, and oversee the Company’s day-to-day operations. The Executive’s principal work location and any additional material duties shall be agreed in writing. Employment shall be at will to the extent permitted by applicable law, subject to the Company’s contractual payment obligations and any mandatory legal protections.

2. COMPENSATION. The Executive’s annual Base Salary, payment frequency, benefits eligibility, and any bonus or equity arrangements remain to be proposed following client confirmation and agreed in writing. No compensation amount or entitlement is established by this placeholder.

3. SEVERANCE. Any contractual severance upon termination without Cause shall be subject to agreement on its amount or formula, payment timing, eligibility conditions, the definition of Cause, and any Good Reason termination right. Any agreed contractual severance shall be conditioned on the Executive executing and not revoking an enforceable release of claims, subject to applicable law and agreed execution and revocation periods. Accrued compensation, vested benefits, and any mandatory termination entitlements shall be addressed separately and shall not be conditioned on a release where prohibited by law.

4. RESTRICTIVE COVENANTS. No post-employment non-compete is agreed at this stage. Any proposed restrictive covenant shall be separately negotiated after confirmation of governing law and relevant work locations, and shall be narrowly tailored as to restricted activities, duration, geographic scope where relevant, and any required consideration, consistent with applicable law.

partner.private_reasoning: The rendered agreement and cover note contain no confidential seller pricing information or other apparent disclosure of the protected negotiating position. No hidden-content categories are identified in the supplied package as requiring removal.

receiver.message_back: The COO reporting line and operational remit are acceptable in principle, but all terms remain subject to client approval and agreement on the complete package; we will seek confirmation of the outstanding identifying, corporate, and work-location details without inventing them. Please provide your client’s confirmed compensation and severance proposal, including Cause and Good Reason definitions and payment timing, with accrued compensation, vested benefits, and mandatory entitlements protected independently of any release; no post-employment non-compete is agreed.
